newsitem.title: USA: Delaware Governor signs 1998 capital spending bill.
newsitem.headline: Delaware Governor signs 1998 capital spending bill.

text.p: Delaware Gov. Thomas Carper said Wednesday he signed the state's 1998 capital spending bill into law.
The bill includes $125.2 million for transportation spending and $179.9 million for projects ranging from school construction to prison expansion.
In addition, the bill allots $37 million to the 21st Century Fund for environmental protection.
Carper also highlighted the bill's provision of $38 million in capital spending for public schools and another $27 million for colleges and universities.

"Because a vibrant economy helped the state to reap additional unanticipated cash for the next two years, we were also in a position to provide $12 million to directly benefit counties and municipalities statewide," Carper said in a statement.
